companyDescription: Nuclear/Quantum Materials · Aerodynamic Separation Process + Quantum Enrichment tech — enriching Silicon-28, Ytterbium-176, Carbon-14 + HALEU nuclear fuel; first-ever commercial isotope shipments targeted Q3 2026
priceNote: Live $1.87 (+3.31%) on Nov 4, 2026 — down ~36% from $2.93 at the Sep 29 report, near the $1.80 52-week low (high $9.38); 52-week range $1.80-$9.38. Nov 4 tape: S&P futures -1.2% / Nasdaq -2% on a Democratic midterm sweep; Dec 9 hike ~85% priced.
summary: REFRESH (prior report Sep 29, 2026): the Q3 target for the first commercial Silicon-28 shipment has passed with no confirmation found, and Q2 EPS missed (-$0.28 vs -$0.17). Quantum Leap Energy cut its convertible debt 50% via a $109M debt-for-equity exchange (~23M new ASPI shares), and H1 net loss was ~$61M. Q3 results are expected ~mid-Nov (last year Nov 19); the shipment confirmation is now the gating event. Base cut from +45% to +35% (above the lane's realized 30d P75 (+12.2%; written-Base bias +72.7pp)), assuming a confirmed first Si-28 shipment with the Q3 report within ~1-3 months. แนะนำ 1% ของ portfolio เท่านั้น — ถ้า thesis fail ลงได้ 50-70%.

catalysts.name: Q3 2026 results — Si-28 shipment confirmation
catalysts.description: Expected ~mid-Nov (prior year Nov 19). Confirmation of the first commercial Silicon-28 shipment (Q3 target) is the gating item.

risks: Repeated technical delays — the Si-28 facility already slipped once (Oct 2025 laser/power-surge damage → 7-month rebuild); a second Q3 2026 slip would break the near-term thesis this report is priced on

Pre-revenue-scale stage — H1 2026 revenue was only $9.3M against a $60.7M operating loss; the company is funding two capex-intensive build-outs (isotope enrichment + natural gas assets) simultaneously

Dilution risk — active ~$106M resale shelf registration (Jul 2026) plus a ~$36.7M ESOP-related shelf; further capital raises are plausible if the isotope ramp needs more capex, even though current runway itself is not urgent
Customer concentration — the Si-28 commercial case rests on 3 disclosed US contracts plus a ~$9M supply deal; delay or loss of any one materially changes the read on "first shipment" success
Single-site production risk — enrichment capacity is concentrated in Pretoria, South Africa, where a 2025 power surge already halted production once

estimateDates.note: Expected ~mid-Nov (prior year Nov 19). Confirmation of the first commercial Silicon-28 shipment (Q3 target) is the gating item.

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed held at 3.75–4.00% on Oct 28 (10–2 vote; Cook and Hammack dissented for a hike). Futures price ~85% odds of another +25bp at the Dec 9 FOMC after Logan and Musalem called for more tightening; Warsh gave no explicit December signal.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Sep PCE: headline 3.6% y/y (+0.5% m/m), core 3.1% y/y (+0.3% m/m); Q3 GDP +3.4% annualized. Oct CPI on Nov 10 is the next test — core ≥0.4% m/m would effectively lock in the December hike.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: Nuclear/critical-materials names have kept a policy-driven risk premium (AI power demand, US isotope supply-chain onshoring) that has partly decoupled them from the standard rate-sensitivity playbook — but ASPI is small/illiquid enough that a broad risk-off move in speculative small caps would hit it disproportionately regardless of the Fed's stance on nuclear policy specifically.
macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM — a cash-burning pre-commercial materials company funding through equity is exposed to a December hike.

catalystSpot.preRunup: Nuclear-fuel-cycle / isotope names tend to pre-run on ANY positive proof point ahead of the actual shipment — not just the shipment itself. ASPI's own May 2026 facility-restart news (still a precursor, not the shipment) triggered an immediate one-day pop.
catalystSpot.preRunupTiming: 1-4 สัปดาห์ก่อน event

postWin.range: +24% (single-day precursor pop, ASPI) to +700%+ (multi-quarter re-rating, LEU)
postWin.note: n=1 for this exact catalystType in skill-feedback (Tier 1, context only) — do not treat as a reliable average. ASPI's own May 2026 restart news popped +24% same day; Centrus (LEU) re-rated from ~$684M to ~$5.5B market cap over the ~18 months following its Nov 2023 first HALEU delivery, though that move mixed the delivery proof-point with separate DOE policy tailwinds.

postLose.note: No clean single-stock precedent for a FAILED first-shipment on ASPI itself; using the turbo lane's overall medianMAE (-24.1%, skill-feedback.json) as the directional anchor since delivery_beat's own n=1 sample can't support a standalone estimate. ASPI already sold off hard on the Oct 2025 equipment-failure delay disclosure, though the exact single-day % was not independently re-verified this run.

spotSizing.reason: 1%. The dated catalyst's type has n<5 (context only), so the weak lane prior governs (hitRate 4.9%, medianExcess +2.0pp, n=41). The Q3 shipment slipped silently — floor size.

comparableCases.event: First commercial HALEU delivery to US DOE, completing Phase 1 of its enrichment contract
comparableCases.note: Centrus's market cap grew from ~$684M to ~$5.5B over the ~18 months following its first HALEU delivery — the closest real analog to ASPI's Si-28 situation (small-cap proving out a novel domestic enrichment process for the first time), though the move mixed the delivery proof-point with separate DOE/policy tailwinds, so it's a multi-quarter re-rating case, not a single-day pop.

comparableCases.event: Restart of Silicon-28 enrichment facility + Q3 2026 shipment timeline reaffirmed (precursor news, not the shipment itself)
comparableCases.note: Same company, same catalyst chain, one step earlier — shows the market already reacts sharply to any credible Si-28 proof point. The actual first shipment (this report's catalyst) is a stronger, more concrete milestone than a facility restart, so the reaction could be larger — or could disappoint if volumes/pricing undersell expectations.

catalysts.description: วัตถุดิบไอโซโทปทางการแพทย์ เป้า H2 2026

risks: Delay ซ้ำได้ — โรงงาน Si-28 เคย delay มาแล้วครั้งนึง (ไฟกระชากทำลายอุปกรณ์ ต.ค. 2025 → ซ่อม 7 เดือน) ถ้า Q3 2026 หลุดอีกรอบ thesis ของรายงานนี้จะพังทันที
ยังอยู่ระดับ pre-revenue-scale — รายได้ H1 2026 แค่ $9.3M เทียบ operating loss $60.7M บริษัทกำลังลงทุนสร้างสองธุรกิจพร้อมกัน (isotope enrichment + natural gas assets)
ความเสี่ยง dilution — มี shelf registration ~$106M (ก.ค. 2026) ที่ยังแอคทีฟ บวก ESOP shelf ~$36.7M มีโอกาสระดมทุนเพิ่มถ้า isotope ramp ต้องการ capex มากขึ้น แม้ runway ปัจจุบันจะยังไม่เร่งด่วน
ลูกค้ากระจุกตัว — เคส Si-28 พึ่งสัญญาสหรัฐฯ 3 รายบวกดีล ~$9M ถ้าสัญญาใดสัญญาหนึ่ง delay หรือหลุด จะกระทบภาพ "ส่งของสำเร็จ" ทันที
ความเสี่ยงจากศูนย์ผลิตเดียว — enrichment รวมศูนย์ที่ Pretoria แอฟริกาใต้ ซึ่งเคยไฟดับหยุดผลิตมาแล้วรอบนึงเมื่อปี 2025

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed คงดอกเบี้ย 3.75–4.00% เมื่อ 28 ต.ค. (โหวต 10–2, Cook และ Hammack ต้องการขึ้น) futures ให้โอกาสขึ้นอีก 25bp ในประชุม 9 ธ.ค. ราว 85% หลัง Logan และ Musalem เรียกร้องให้คุมเข้มต่อ ส่วน Warsh ไม่ส่งสัญญาณชัดเรื่อง ธ.ค.
macroRisk.inflationNote: PCE ก.ย.: headline 3.6% y/y (+0.5% m/m), core 3.1% y/y (+0.3% m/m); GDP Q3 +3.4% CPI ต.ค. วันที่ 10 พ.ย. คือบททดสอบถัดไป — ถ้า core ≥0.4% m/m แทบล็อกการขึ้นดอกเบี้ย ธ.ค.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: หุ้นสาย nuclear/critical materials มี risk premium จาก policy (ความต้องการไฟฟ้าจาก AI, การดึง isotope supply chain กลับสหรัฐฯ) ที่แยกตัวจากวงจรดอกเบี้ยปกติบางส่วน แต่ ASPI เล็กและสภาพคล่องต่ำพอที่ risk-off รอบใหญ่ใน small cap เก็งกำไรจะกระทบหนักกว่าค่าเฉลี่ย
